title: Zero to RAG (Azure AI Search as Vector Store)

cues.en: Hi, and this is a companion video to my Zero2Rack main video, where we went through all the steps of going from Zero2Rack.
cues.zh: 大家好，這是 Zero to RAG 主影片的補充教學；主影片已經帶大家完成從零開始建立 RAG 的所有步驟。

cues.en: In this video, I'm going to show how we connect to Azure AI Search instead of in-memory.
cues.zh: 這次要示範如何把記憶體儲存區改成 Azure AI Search。

cues.en: Azure AI Search is an online tool, of course, so we need to create the resource.
cues.zh: Azure AI Search 是線上服務，所以當然需要先建立資源。

cues.en: The other ones have mostly just been getting some NuGet packages or installing a SQL server,
cues.zh: 其他範例大多只要取得 NuGet 套件，或安裝 SQL Server，

cues.en: but this one requires a resource, and since it's Zero2, the full setup, I'm going to show you how to make one of those as well.
cues.zh: 但這次需要雲端資源。既然要示範從零完成整套設定，我也會帶你建立這個資源。

cues.en: So we are simply going to make a resource called Azure AI Search.
cues.zh: 我們要建立的資源就叫 Azure AI Search。

cues.en: We're going to create one of these, I'll put it in my sandbox here, I'm going to call it
cues.zh: 新增一個，放進我的 Sandbox，名稱設成，

cues.en: RWJYouTube, and let's just keep it here.
cues.zh: RWJYouTube，其他先保持這樣。

cues.en: Azure AI Search, in general, is a really expensive thing.
cues.zh: 一般來說，Azure AI Search 是一項費用比較高的服務，

cues.en: The main thing being that the prices are pretty high, and you also pay, no matter what, you can turn it off and on, and it's not usage-based only.
cues.zh: 主要是定價較高，而且不只是根據實際用量收費，即使沒有使用，也可能持續產生費用。

cues.en: So there's a bunch of pricing tiers with various different costs.
cues.zh: 它有許多定價層，各自對應不同費用。

cues.en: I don't want to use $5,000 per month here, but luckily there's a free tier, which is enough for what I need to do here.
cues.zh: 我不想在這裡每個月花五千美元，幸好有免費層，足夠這個範例使用。

cues.en: So you can definitely try it out, but be wary about higher than that, it will definitely cost you money.
cues.zh: 所以你可以試用，但如果選擇更高的層級，就要留意會產生費用。

cues.en: I'm going to build the free tier, I'm just going to create it, and I will pause the video
cues.zh: 我會建立免費層，按下建立，接著先暫停影片，

cues.en: until it's actually created, because it can take a little while.
cues.zh: 等它建立完成，因為可能需要一些時間。

cues.en: Now a few minutes later, and I have my resource here.
cues.zh: 幾分鐘過去了，資源已經建立完成。

cues.en: So we have our search, and in order to use that search, we're going to need the URL, and let me jump to some sample code here.
cues.zh: 現在有了搜尋服務，要使用它，需要取得網址。接著來看看範例程式碼。

cues.en: We have an Azure AI Search here, that does exactly the same as the original video so
cues.zh: 這裡的 Azure AI Search 專案，目前都與原本影片相同，

cues.en: far, but we want to put in an Azure AI Search endpoint URL.
cues.zh: 但需要填入 Azure AI Search 的端點網址，

cues.en: And the search key, and I'm going to show the key now, that's because when you see this
cues.zh: 以及搜尋金鑰。現在我會展示這把金鑰，原因是等你看到這支，

cues.en: video, this resource has already been removed again, so I can allow myself to do that, but
cues.zh: 影片時，這個資源已經刪除了，所以這裡可以展示。但在實際環境中，

cues.en: in real life, of course, you shouldn't have it be shown.
cues.zh: 當然不應該讓金鑰公開。

cues.en: I'm going to put that in, and the only thing we need to do, like in other companion apps,
cues.zh: 我把它貼上。接著與其他補充範例一樣，只需要修改，

cues.en: is to change how we define our VectorStore.
cues.zh: VectorStore 的定義方式。

cues.en: We don't want in-memory, we want an Azure AI Search, and for that, we need a new nugget package.
cues.zh: 不再使用 InMemory，而是改用 Azure AI Search；為此，需要一個新的 NuGet 套件。

cues.en: So we go to VectorStore, UnityToolkits.VectorData, and one of the ones we have here is Azure AI Search.
cues.zh: 搜尋 CommunityToolkit.VectorData，可以看到其中一個選項是 Azure AI Search。

cues.en: We're going to put that in, and once we have that, we can write Azure AI Search VectorStore.
cues.zh: 安裝之後，就能使用 AzureAISearchVectorStore。

cues.en: In order to make one of those, we need a search index client, so we can say new search index
cues.zh: 要建立它，需要 SearchIndexClient，所以新增一個 SearchIndexClient，

cues.en: client, with a new URI, that would be our endpoint, and with a key, which is our Azure AI Search key.
cues.zh: 傳入新的 Uri，也就是服務端點，再加上 Azure AI Search 金鑰。

cues.en: One thing we're going to put in, let me check the right places here, is we're going to put
cues.zh: 還有一項需要設定，我先確認一下正確的位置，也就是加入，

cues.en: in the store options, and those options will be exactly the same as before with our embedding general.
cues.zh: 儲存區選項，內容與之前完全相同，傳入原本的嵌入生成器。

cues.en: And that's everything we need to change, we would think.
cues.zh: 乍看之下，需要修改的就只有這些。

cues.en: Let me try to run it, and we will see a small change.
cues.zh: 但來執行看看，就會發現還有一個小地方要調整。

cues.en: I have already put it in, but in the other cases, we have written it like this, my collection,
cues.zh: 我已經先修改過了，不過在其他範例中，我們使用的是像 MyCollection 這樣的名稱，

cues.en: but again, different VectorStores, different rules about names and IDs and stuff.
cues.zh: 但不同向量儲存區，對名稱、ID 等資訊都有各自的規則。

cues.en: If we run it like this, it will actually fail, saying, index name must contain lowercase letters, digits, and dashes.
cues.zh: 如果這樣執行，就會失敗，指出索引名稱必須使用小寫字母、數字及連字號。

cues.en: So this name I chose that works in some VectorStores, don't work in others.
cues.zh: 所以我選的名稱，在部分向量儲存區能用，在其他儲存區卻不行。

cues.en: You will probably only use one, so it doesn't really matter, I tend to put them lowercase and dashes, everything, so I can switch around if I need to.
cues.zh: 你可能只會使用一種，因此影響不大。我自己通常會統一用小寫與連字號，方便有需要時切換。

cues.en: But beyond that, it's exactly the same code, it runs in exactly the same way, it's just
cues.zh: 除此之外，程式碼完全相同，運作方式也一樣，只是，

cues.en: a different VectorStore now, and we get our answer back.
cues.zh: 換了向量儲存區，接著仍然能取得答案。

cues.en: If we have a look in here, we can go up in search management and look at the indexes,
cues.zh: 到服務裡看看，在 Search management 裡查看 Indexes，

cues.en: and we now have an index of my collection.
cues.zh: 現在就有 my-collection 這個索引。

cues.en: Look into it and search, we can see our different entries, and which is one of them, the very long vector here.
cues.zh: 開啟並搜尋，可以看到不同資料項目，其中也包含這段很長的向量。

cues.en: Just like in SQL Server and all the others, it's stored in a slightly different manner,
cues.zh: 和 SQL Server 及其他儲存區一樣，資料的儲存方式稍有不同，

cues.en: in this case it's some JSON it's in, but it is all abstracted away from us when we
cues.zh: 這裡使用的是 JSON，但當我們透過，

cues.en: work with the vector data extension.
cues.zh: VectorData 擴充功能操作時，這些差異都已經被抽象化。

cues.en: So we have our 10 count, this is plenty for the free version, so that's okay, but if you have more, of course you need to begin to pay.
cues.zh: 目前只有十筆資料，對免費版本來說很足夠。但如果資料更多，當然就可能需要付費。

cues.en: But beyond that, there's nothing more to it when we go to the Azure AI search.
cues.zh: 除此之外，改用 Azure AI Search 就沒有其他特別的地方。

cues.en: I tend to not use them because of the pricing, but they are nice, easy, especially if I only
cues.zh: 我自己比較少用，主要是價格的考量。不過它確實好用，也很容易設定，尤其如果只有，

cues.en: have a few data like this, but I easily hit the free tier limits often, so that's not
cues.zh: 像這樣少量的資料。但我通常很容易超過免費層上限，所以，

cues.en: what I'm normally doing, I'm using SQL Server normally.
cues.zh: 平常主要還是使用 SQL Server。

cues.en: But that's everything, very simple to switch, and you are in run.
cues.zh: 以上就是全部內容，切換很簡單，設定好就能執行。

cues.en: So see you in the next one.
cues.zh: 我們下一支影片再見。
